asked.item: Where to add VAT number themselves

verdict.reason: S21-S27 state how to add a VAT or tax ID to invoices through the billing portal.

steps.text: Go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal".
Open your billing information and update your company name and address.
Insert your VAT or tax ID directly in the Tax ID field.
Your VAT or tax ID then appears on future invoices.
